newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * Galoob Toys Inc said it expects record 1997 sales and that its holiday retail sales are running 34 percent ahead of 1995. It said 1996 sales would come in between $280 and $290 million, against $220 million in 1995. It expects 1996 earnings per share of $1.20 to $1.25 before charges. The stock closed at 17-1/2 on Tuesday.

* European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said the proposed merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp might raise questions about the combined companies' dominant position in the European Union.
Van Miert said the matter could be "complex and problematic."
Boeing closed at 101 while McDonnell Douglas ended at 61-7/8.
* Jabil Circuit Inc shares rose 2-7/8 to 35 in after-hours trading Tuesday. The company reported higher first quarter earnings of $0.47 a share, against $0.31 a year ago.
* American Home Products Corp said it was excercising its option to buy the 40 percent interest in Genetics Institute Inc that it did not already own.
American Home said it would pay about $1.0 billion.
American Home closed at 59-1/4 while Genetics Institute closed at 61-3/4.
